author: ThRaccoon
title: Rating prompt, and sound quality
content:
Most apps let users skip user reviews -- not like remind me later, but an option to not review.  It's kind of hostile when that's not an option at all.

The sound quality is also really weird when played at different speed (Speed up or slow down.)  I speed up the same (audiobook) tracks in itunes and ibooks and they sound fine, they only sound choppy in Evermusic.

Crashes from time to time so I lose my place in long audiobooks.

Also missing the ffw/ rewind 15 sec options in ipad.
